The project's objective is to recommission the currently disused S3A building to accommodate empty or fueled payloads before their resume campaigns at the S3B/S1 or S5 EPCUs and/or the EFA.

The objective is to meet the increased production rate at the Launch Base and guarantee the availability of the EPCUs.

 

CNES has defined a payload storage strategy that takes into account the SVG constraints and those related to the overall building rehabilitation.

 

S3A is a former filling and encapsulation building with existing installations and systems:

Propellant retention systems in the highbays
Three cranes in the filling and encapsulation halls
An air conditioning system including a toxic vapor extraction function
An obsolete fluid and air network for operational activities and maintaining the building's airtightness
An obsolete toxic gas treatment system in the filling halls
Technical rooms
 

All of these systems will be upgraded to meet the project's objectives.
